SettingsWindow.UseCustomSpeedTestUrl: Specify the path to your own file for measuring speed:
SettingsWindow.UseCustomSpeedTestUrlTool:
The speed test downloads a file from a server: the app fetches it in 4 streams and starts over when the file ends, until the test time runs out.

Enter a direct link to a file on your own site or hosting, for example: https://your-site.com/speedtest.bin

The file name can be anything; the link just has to open the file itself, not a web page. A large file (100 MB or more) works best, e.g. speedtest.bin.
SettingsWindow.SpeedTestUrlHint: Speed test file URL. If unchecked or empty, the built-in default URL is used.
SettingsWindow.TrayClickQuickSingleOpenD: Single click – quick measurement, double click – application window.

SettingsWindow.PlaySoundOnReconnect: Play a sound when the internet comes back
SettingsWindow.ShowRegionInWindow: Show the country by IP address in the main window
SettingsWindow.ShowRegionIcon: Show a second icon with the region flag
SettingsWindow.RegionEnhancedTooltip:
Normally the country comes from your public IP address. With a VPN on, that is the VPN server's country, not yours.

In enhanced mode the app also sends a request that bypasses the VPN — straight through your network card or Wi-Fi — and shows the country you are actually in. An orange dot appears on the flag, and the tooltip shows both countries.

This does not work with every VPN: if the VPN has leak protection (kill switch) on, the bypass request is blocked and the IP country is shown.
